O. C. (Special Branch)
P.A. (Crime and Special Branches).

The reorganization scheme provides that men of
certain rank shall hold definite positions in the various
branches of the Force and that promotion to higher rank
will, if necessary, involve transfer of the men promoted
to positions in any branch of the Force where vacancies
exist for men of that rank. The object aimed at is to
obtain general all round efficiency in police work as
against a system whereby specialists were created and
co-ordination, efficiency and equal treatment were impossible,
and wherein men in such positions never really assumed the
responsibility of the rank they held. The Crime and
Special Branches have been no exception and it now becomes
necessary to bring these branches into line with the
remainder of the Force. To do this, I am of opinion, that
changes in organization are necessary. The following
changes will, therefore, be made as soon as possible.

The use of the present nomenclature of sections
tends to independence of action, lack of co-operation and
specialization. It is of no use to anyone except for
internal reference, but is likely to give undue importance
to individual work performed, to the detriment of efficiency
and discipline in the Crime and Special Branches. The
reference difficulty can be overcome by the following method
which will be brought into force as soon as possible.

Special Branch.

重组方案规定，特定警衔的人员应在警务处各部门担任固定职位，晋升至更高警衔时，如有必要，涉及将晋升人员调往警务处任何部门中该警衔有空缺的职位。其目标在于获得警务工作的全面整体效率，而非那种制造专家、导致协调、效率和公平待遇无法实现、且身处此类职位的人员从未真正承担其所持警衔责任的制度。刑事及特务处也不例外，现在有必要使这些部门与警务处其余部分保持一致。为此，我认为必须进行组织变革。因此，将尽快实施以下变更。

目前使用的科室名称倾向于导致行动独立、缺乏合作和专业化。除了内部参考外，这对任何人都没有用处，但可能会过分强调个人所做的工作，从而损害刑事及特务处的效率和纪律。参考困难可以通过以下方法克服，该方法将尽快实施。

It is advisable that all members of the Special Branch should have a knowledge of Crime Branch work at Stations, and arrangements should be made to transfer those who have not had this experience as opportunity offers without loss of efficiency to the Branch. So far as foreigners are concerned it is advisable that all members of the Special Branch engaged on enquiry work, should be trained police officers and only in very exceptional cases and for special work should the engagement of inexperienced men be considered. The Officer in charge of the Branch will be
responsible to the D.C. (C&SB) for all matters appertaining
to the Branch and will keep in touch with D.O.s in regard
to the matters affecting the peace and good order of
the Settlement, but should strictly avoid passing on
verbal information without written records.

The Superintendent will personally take charge
of S.I but will, in addition, assist the O i/c Branch
in the control and organization of the staff and work
generally. He is expected to keep in touch with all the
work of the Branch and, therefore, should be in close
communication with the O.C. Branch at all times, and will
assume control during temporary absences of that officer
unless otherwise directed.

To avoid delay in transmission of correspondence
it will not be necessary for the Superintendent to read
and sign reports from other sections, but he will see all
important papers at the discretion of the O.C. Branch.
It is his duty to check the rough draft of the Daily
Report after compilation by his immediate junior in
S.I and when typed and completed he will sign and pass
forward to O.C. Branch. The latter will, whenever possible,
present the report daily at 10.30 a.m. to D.C. (C&SB)
when matters of importance concerning the work and staff
can be discussed.

The P.A. (C&SB) will take charge of all
administration work of the Branches in co-operation with
the O.C. Special Branch, but acting under final instructions
of the D.C. (C&SB), who will approve all drafts for Police
orders.

处室主管官员应对属于本处室的所有事务向刑事及特务处副处长 (D.C. (C&SB)) 负责，并就影响租界和平与秩序的事务与各分局局长 (D.O.s) 保持联系，但应严格避免在无书面记录的情况下传递口头信息。

警司将亲自负责S.I（情报股），此外，还将协助处室主管官员控制和管理员工及总体工作。预计他将与本处室的所有工作保持联系，因此，应随时与处室主管官员保持密切沟通，并在该官员暂时缺席期间接管控制权，除非另有指示。

为避免信件传递延误，警司无需阅读和签署其他科室的报告，但他将根据处室主管官员的酌情权查看所有重要文件。他的职责是在S.1（情报股）的直接下属编制完每日报告草稿后进行核对，待打印完成后签字并转呈处室主管官员。后者将尽可能在每日上午10时30分向刑事及特务处副处长 (D.C. (C&SB)) 呈报该报告，届时可讨论有关工作和员工的重要事项。

刑事及特务处助理处长 (P.A. (C&SB)) 将与特务处处长合作，负责各处室的行政工作，但在刑事及特务处副处长 (D.C. (C&SB)) 的最终指令下行事，后者将批准所有警务命令草案。

The censorship of Cinema films will be under
the direct control of the U.C. Branch, the Chief Inspector
now supervising being responsible for all records and
arrangements for inspection etc. Matters of special
importance affecting the Police or Council should be
immediately reported on for the information of C.P. When
not otherwise engaged this officer will conduct enquiries
in connection with the work of S.B.I. and will assist
the Superintendent in the control of the office and staff.
Whilst the Special Branch are now responsible for Cinema
films censorship the arrangements should be such that
the normal work of the Branch is not interfered with and,
if necessary, the assistance of senior officers at Police
stations should be requisitioned through D.U.s.

The organisation of S.B.I is a matter for
careful consideration of the O.C. Branch and Superintendent,
but each foreign officer in it should be made responsible
for a section of its work and care should be taken that
there is no overlapping, outside enquiries being conducted
by any member of the staff under the direction of the
Superintendent in charge. It should be understood that
it is just as much the duty of the Foreign Officers
of this section to obtain personal information of Foreign
and Chinese criminal and political matters as it is of
the Chinese staff, and failure to do so and to report
thereon can only show lack of interest in the work.

The Narcotics and Boarding House enquiries
will be taken over by the Crime Branch as soon as office
accommodation can be found for them, but in the meantime
they will remain as at present.

特别调查股（S.B.I.）的组织架构需由该股主管（O.C. Branch）和警司慎重考虑，但其中的每名外籍警官均应对某一部分工作负责，并应注意避免工作重叠，任何职员在外勤调查时均须在负责警司的指导下进行。必须明确，该股外籍警官在获取有关外籍人士和华人的刑事及政治情报方面的职责，与华籍职员相同，未能履行此职责并就此报告，只能表明其对工作缺乏兴趣。

一旦找到办公场所，毒品及寄宿公寓调查工作将移交刑事股（Crime Branch），但在此之前，仍维持现状。

Headquarters, (now designated "Personal Assistant (Crime
& Special Branches") but Inspector Sharman on his return
will personally supervise C.I. 3, 4, 5 & 6 and will make
himself acquainted with the routine and, so far as possible,
the work of C.I. 2, and will generally assist the P.A.
This position will in future be considered a permanent
portion of Crime and Special Branch organization and the
encumbent will be expected to act for the P.A. should
necessity arise.

It is essential that the Narcotic enquiry staff
function under the control of the Superintendent or
Senior detective C.I. I, so that the staff of that section
will be available at any time for raids or assistance
to the Inspector directly responsible. The officer i/c
of the Narcotic squad should always be in possession of
uniform and wear it on the occasions when it is necessary
in connection with his work. The Chinese officers attached
to that staff should also be in possession of uniform. The
Chinese staff of C.I. I will assist at the discretion
of the Senior detective in Charge.

The Boarding House enquiries will be conducted as
at present, the staff consisting of one British and one
Russian detective with a 1st Class Chinese Clerk in
charge of the files. The work of this Section demands very
close co-operation with S.I. 2 and the officer in charge of
the latter section will keep in close touch with the
Senior Detective C.I. I in this matter and also in
connection with enquiries likely to develop into criminal
matters. The Officer in charge C.I. I is responsible for
all investigations conducted by his staff under the direct
control of the D.C. (C&SB). He will take over from

（现称“助理专员（刑事及特别股）”），但夏曼（Sharman）督察返岗后，将亲自监督 C.I. 3、4、5 及 6 的工作，熟悉 C.I. 2 的日常运作及尽可能了解其工作内容，并一般性地协助助理专员。该职位今后将被视为刑事及特别股组织中的常设部分，任职者需在必要时代理助理专员职务。

至关重要的是，毒品调查组必须在警司或高级侦探 C.I. 1 的控制下运作，以便该组人员能随时配合突袭行动或协助直接负责的督察。毒品小队的主管警官应始终备有制服，并在工作需要时穿着。隶属该组的华籍警官也应备有制服。C.I. 1 的华籍职员将在负责高级侦探的酌情决定下提供协助。

寄宿公寓调查工作将按目前方式进行，人员由一名英籍侦探、一名俄籍侦探及一名负责档案的一等华籍文员组成。该股的工作需要与 S.I. 2 密切合作，后者主管警官在此事上以及与可能发展为刑事案件的相关调查上，应与高级侦探 C.I. 1 保持密切联系。C.I. 1 主管警官对在副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 直接控制下由其职员进行的所有调查负责。他将从

stations the investigation of such cases as the latter
may direct. The procedure in regard to crime diaries
of cases will be as follows:- Stations will record
F.I.R.s but on taking over a case C.I.D. I will also take
over all diaries, papers and exhibits connected with the
case. So far as practicable all enquiries will be conducted
from the Stations in which the Crime is first reported
and all persons arrested will be charged from that Station
except when investigations can be more efficiently
conducted from another Station, in which case D.C. (C&SB)
should be consulted before a transfer of prisoners is
made. Persons arrested by the staff of C.I.D. I should be
taken to the nearest Police station and, if possible, the
case should be conducted from that station provided no
previous arrests have been made and the case is not under
investigation elsewhere either by the staff of C.I.D. I
or the Station detective staff.
Co-operation between C.I.D. I and station staffs is
essential and the Senior detective in charge will request
assistance of the D.D.O. should he require it when
investigating cases taken over from a station. It is
not necessary to supply copies of diaries to D.D.O.s
unless specially asked for, but he (D.D.O.) should see
the complete file occasionally (confidentially when
necessary) to enable him to keep in touch with the progress
of the enquiries. The members of the staff of C.I.D. I
should understand that nothing in these instructions
should be taken as precluding them from acting in a normal
detective capacity in regard to any case, and failure to
obtain information, or having obtained it, failure to
follow it up or to co-operate fully with stations, will
be considered as neglect of duty and severely dealt with.

各分局接管后者指示的案件调查。关于案件犯罪日志的程序如下：- 各分局记录首次报案记录（F.I.R.s），但在接管案件时，刑事调查一处（C.I.D. I）也将接管与该案相关的所有日志、文件和证物。在可行范围内，所有调查均应在首次报案的分局进行，所有被捕人员均应由该分局提出指控，除非从另一分局进行调查效率更高，在这种情况下，转移囚犯前应咨询副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)]。由 C.I.D. I 职员逮捕的人员应送往最近的警察局，如果此前未进行过逮捕，且该案未由 C.I.D. I 职员或分局侦探人员在其他地方进行调查，则尽可能由该警局办理此案。
C.I.D. I 与分局职员之间的合作至关重要，负责的高级侦探在调查从分局接管的案件时，如需协助，应向副分区巡官（D.D.O.）请求。除非特别要求，否则无需向副分区巡官（D.D.O.）提供日志副本，但他（D.D.O.）应偶尔查看完整档案（必要时保密），以便了解调查进展。C.I.D. I 的职员应明白，本指示中的任何内容均不应被视为禁止他们在任何案件中行使正常侦探职能，未能获取情报，或获取后未能跟进或与分局充分合作，将被视为玩忽职守，并受到严厉惩处。

page_data.en:

C.I. 2 will function as at present, but the junior
members of the staff will be transferable for C.B. work at
Stations at intervals, and be replaced by selected men from
Station staffs. The Sub Inspector in Charge will make
the necessary arrangements at intervals, being careful not
to cause loss of efficiency in the Section by the changes.
At least two members of the staff of this office should
have a knowledge of Arms identification and photographic
work.

Officers of this section will not attend Court
to give expert evidence without permission of D.C. (C&SB).

The Sub Inspector in Charge of C.I. 3 will be
held responsible that the necessary enquiries are made
concerning each applicant for firearms licenses and that
the detectives reports forwarded are complete. He is
permitted to avail himself of the services of Station
detectives, C.I. I and S.I. I and 2 in accordance with
the above instructions, and should forward complete file
to P.A.(C&SB) before the issue of a license. The latter
officer will sign all licenses "for D.C. (C&SB)", but must
submit all "refusals" to that officer for final decision.

Complimentary licenses will not be issued
without the approval of the D.C. (C&SB).

Licenses will not be renewed until the relative
office file has been examined, the pistol presented for
examination, and the bona-fides of the possessor ascertained.

A quarterly return of all arms kept by the
section will be forwarded to D.C. (C&SB) with recommendations
for disposal.

Licenses will not be issued to any person until
tested and classified by C.I. 4.

C.I. 2 将按目前方式运作，但该组的初级成员将定期调往各分局从事刑事股（C.B.）工作，并由从分局职员中挑选的人员接替。主管副督察将定期进行必要安排，注意避免因人员变动导致该股效率降低。该办公室至少应有两名职员具备枪支识别和摄影工作知识。

未经副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 许可，该股警官不得出庭提供专家证词。

C.I. 3 主管副督察须负责对每位枪支许可证申请人进行必要调查，并确保提交的侦探报告完整无误。根据上述指示，他获准利用分局侦探、C.I. 1 以及 S.I. 1 和 2 的服务，并在颁发许可证前将完整档案送交助理专员（刑事及特别股）[P.A.(C&SB)]。后者将以“代表副警务处长（刑事及特别股）”的名义签署所有许可证，但必须将所有“拒发”案例提交该官员做最终决定。

未经副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 批准，不得颁发礼遇性许可证。

在查阅相关办公档案、出示手枪供检查并核实持有人的真实身份之前，不得续发许可证。

该股保管的所有枪支的季度报表，连同处置建议，将送交副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)]。

The officer in charge of C.I. 4 will receive all
arms presented for examination and classification,
personally, and will not accept any without official labels.
He will give a receipt to the person presenting the arms
and will not return any weapon until a final report has
been submitted to D.C. (C&SB), and the original receipt
is returned to him for file with the report. He will not
attend Court in connection with arms identification at
any time without the permission of the D.C. (C&SB), who
will inspect all documents prepared for presentation as
evidence.

The Sub Inspector in Charge of C.I. 5 will
work in co-operation with all Crime and Special Branch
sections and Registry for the purpose of compiling his
records and will take over all criminal records from
C.I. I. It will be his duty to study all modus operandi
forms and to assist crime investigators by notifying them
of persons suspected. He will study locality, variety
and methods of crime for the purpose of co-ordinating the
work throughout the Settlement and will bring to the notice
of D.C. (C&SB) any special features of interest likely to
aid in investigation or prevention.

So soon as accommodation can be found C.I. 5
will be separated from the C.& S.B. Registry, but in the
meantime every effort will be made to place the modus-operandi
portion of the work in proper order in readiness for the
change.

The C. & S.B. Registry will function as at present,
but on the separation of C.I. 5 only one Police officer
(in charge) will remain in that office, the work being
performed by clerical staff only.

C.I. 4 主管警官将亲自接收所有提交检查和分类的枪支，没有官方标签的一律不予接收。他将向提交枪支的人员出具收据，在向副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 提交最终报告并将原始收据退回以便与报告一起归档之前，不得归还任何武器。未经副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 许可，他任何时候都不得就枪支识别事宜出庭，该官员将检查所有拟作为证据提交的文件。

C.I. 5 主管副督察将与所有刑事及特别股各组及档案室合作，以编制其记录，并从 C.I. 1 接管所有犯罪记录。他的职责是研究所有作案手法表格，并通过通知嫌疑人来协助犯罪调查员。他将研究犯罪的地点、种类和方法，以协调整个租界的工作，并将任何可能有助于调查或预防的有趣特殊特征提请副警务处长（刑事及特别股）[D.C. (C&SB)] 注意。

一旦找到办公场所，C.I. 5 将与刑事及特别股档案室分离，但在此期间，将尽力使作案手法部分的工作井然有序，为变更做好准备。

刑事及特别股档案室将按目前方式运作，但在 C.I. 5 分离后，该办公室只留一名警官（主管），工作仅由文职人员完成。

Except in the case of finger print forms sent
in early in the morning, correspondence or other papers
will be delivered or despatched from the C. & S.B. Registry.
All envelopes will be opened in the Registry except those
addressed personally to individuals. Confidential matters
will be treated as such and passed to the addressee concerned
personally by the officer in charge of the Registry or
under cover. Under no circumstances will correspondence
be passed forward without relative files attached, and these
must circulate intact, or with reference slips attached,
explaining the absence of portions of the file.

The present method of filing useless papers,
translations, press cuttings, etc., will be discontinued
and discretion concerning destruction will be with the
officer in charge of Registry who should consult O.C. (S.B.),
P.A. (C.S.B.) and Supt. (S.B.) when in doubt.

All drafts, useless notes and memos will be
removed from the files before filing and the sequence of
papers on a file will be from bottom to top, each paper
being numbered consecutively.

To avoid delay the Translation Section and Liaison
Officer will act on endorsements and instructions from the
following officers:

O.C. S.B.
Supt. S.B.
P.A. for D.C. (C&SB).

On completion of the work all reports and
translations will be passed through the O.C. (S.B.) for
his final directions.

communicate with Chinese Authorities on important official
matters concerning the Police or Council except on the

除清晨送达的指纹表格外，信件或其他文件均由刑事及特别股档案室递送或发出。除寄给个人的信件外，所有信封均在档案室开启。机密事项将按机密处理，由档案室主管亲自或通过密封方式转交相关收件人。在任何情况下，不得在未附带相关档案的情况下转发信件，这些档案必须完整流转，或附上参考条，说明档案部分缺失的原因。

特别股警司（Supt. S.B.）

All material received into the store will be

On receipt of Divisional reports on the 10th day

关于上海地区中国军队的部署、兵力、武器装备等的详细信息，邻近省份可能影响当地军事局势的战争活动进展，特别是关于对租界及越界筑路地区的和平与良好秩序可能产生的影响。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

NAVAL:
Detailed information re numbers, armament and
movements of Chinese Naval Ships at Shanghai and their
attitude and bearing on the local political situation.

POLITICAL:
(1) Lists of names and addresses of the principal
Chinese political associations in Shanghai, the strength
of their membership and the character of their activities.
(2) Addresses in Shanghai, and in the Settlement
in particular, which are used permanently or from time to
time by important Chinese politicians with particulars
of the names and sympathies of these politicians.
(3) Agitations or actions aiming at undermining
authority of the Chinese Government, Municipal Council,
or tending to prejudice the position of Foreigners generally,
or the people of any particular nation or group.
(4) Political happenings in Chinese territory
of special interest from a police or municipal point of view.
(5) Movements of Chinese political notables.
(6) List of schools and the political tendencies
of their pupils and principals.
(7) Lists of Chinese, other than Communists
engaged on subversive agitation.

LABOUR:
(1) Lists of industrial concerns with number of
hands employed in each, particularly in the Settlement
and outlying roads.
(2) Lists of labour organisations in the
Settlement, Frenchtown and Chinese territory with
particulars of their addresses, principal officers,
political leanings and Communistic tendencies.

海军：

关于在上海的中国海军舰艇的数量、武器装备及动向的详细信息，及其对当地政治局势的态度和影响。

政治：
(1) 上海主要中国政治团体的名称和地址名单、成员人数及其活动性质。
(2) 上海，特别是租界内，被重要中国政治家永久或不定期使用的地址，并附有这些政治家的姓名及政治倾向详情。
(3) 旨在削弱中国政府、工部局权威，或倾向于损害外国人整体地位，或任何特定国家或群体人民地位的煽动或行动。
(4) 从警察或市政角度具有特殊利益的中国领土内的政治事件。
(5) 中国政治名流的动向。
(6) 学校名单及其学生和校长的政治倾向。
(7) 除共产党人外，从事颠覆性煽动活动的中国人名单。

劳工：
(1) 工业企业名单，注明每家企业的雇员人数，特别是在租界及越界筑路地区的企业。
(2) 租界、法租界及中国领土内的劳工组织名单，附有其地址、主要负责人、政治倾向及共产主义倾向的详情。
